title: Mind Your Health virtual therapy
summary: Describes the Mind Your Health virtual therapy membership provided by Teladoc Health, including price, how it works and its limits.

atoms.title: Mind Your Health virtual therapy overview and price
atoms.question: What is Mind Your Health virtual therapy and what does it cost?
atoms.text: Mind Your Health, provided by Teladoc Health, offers access to unlimited online therapy with licensed professionals for $169.99 per month, as mental health care without insurance. UnitedHealthcare says virtual therapy is a great option for people seeking flexible, convenient mental health care. There is a 72-hour wait to access the membership, and members must be 18 or older.

Can I get therapy without insurance?
Who provides Mind Your Health?

atoms.title: Mind Your Health is not insurance
atoms.question: Is Mind Your Health insurance?
atoms.text: Mind Your Health is not health insurance, and members are encouraged to maintain adequate insurance from a responsible provider. It is designed to complement, and not replace, the care received from a primary care physician. Mind Your Health by Teladoc Health and UnitedHealthcare are not affiliated, and each entity is responsible for its own contractual and financial obligations.

atoms.title: What Mind Your Health gives members access to
atoms.question: What does Mind Your Health include?
atoms.text: Mind Your Health offers access to a range of virtual therapists, mental health resources and digital tools. A member's personalized plan could include a mix of telehealth therapy, coaching and online content, plus self-guided tools and activities to work on between sessions. Therapists create the personalized plans based on the member's goals.

atoms.title: Common issues Mind Your Health providers treat
atoms.question: What mental health issues can Mind Your Health help with?
atoms.text: Common issues that Mind Your Health providers treat include anxiety and stress, depression and negative thought patterns, feeling overwhelmed, not feeling like yourself, sleep issues, relationship conflicts, trauma and PTSD, mood swings, and medication management by virtual psychiatrists.

atoms.title: How to schedule a Mind Your Health visit
atoms.question: How do I set up therapy sessions with Mind Your Health?
atoms.text: Once enrolled in Mind Your Health, setting up therapy sessions takes a few steps. 1) Set up an account and answer a few brief questions about preferences and needs. 2) Choose a therapist and pick the dates and times that work best. 3) Meet online at the confirmed time to start the visit.

atoms.title: Eligibility and availability limits for Mind Your Health
atoms.question: Who can use Mind Your Health and when are visits available?
atoms.text: Members must be 18 years or older, and mental health visits are not available to minors. There is a 72-hour wait to access the membership. Mental health visits are scheduled rather than available 24/7, all mental health specialists may not be available in all states, and the service may not be available in certain states.

atoms.title: Prescribing limits for Mind Your Health providers
atoms.question: Can Mind Your Health providers prescribe medication?
atoms.text: Mind Your Health physicians are an independent network of doctors who advise, diagnose and prescribe at their own discretion. They do not prescribe DEA controlled substances, nontherapeutic drugs and certain other drugs that may be harmful because of their potential for abuse. Mind Your Health does not guarantee that a prescription will be written.

atoms.title: Mind Your Health is not for crisis situations
atoms.question: Where do I go for a mental health crisis?
atoms.text: Mind Your Health virtual therapy is not designed to help in a crisis situation. People in crisis should seek help immediately: call or text 988, the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, for emotional distress or suicidal thoughts, or call 911 for immediate, life-threatening needs, including medical crisis, fire, crime or natural disasters.

atoms.title: Resources for existing UnitedHealthcare members
atoms.question: Where can UnitedHealthcare members find mental health programs?
atoms.text: Mind Your Health is offered as mental health care without insurance. For current UnitedHealthcare members, the page directs them to the company's mental health programs and services page. People who want to speak with a licensed insurance agent about membership options can call 888-578-8535.
